detail: Batch execution blocked at the source-list stage: this session's remote environment network policy denies outbound access to all external domains except an allowlist (npmjs.org, pypi.org, github.com/api.github.com, anthropic.com). Attempts to reach dspace.mit.edu, en.wikipedia.org, and www.google.com all failed at the network gateway (403 / connection refused) via both WebFetch and direct curl. WebSearch (Anthropic-hosted, not subject to this container's egress policy) remains available but returns only search snippets, not full page/PDF content, so it cannot be used to verify official pages or extract acknowledgments text without risking fabrication. No thesis list, PDF, or acknowledgments data has been collected yet for this batch.
